overview: A modified commercial confocal Raman microscope used to map phonon spectra under controlled heating or electrical bias. Temperature and stress are separated through calibration, mode selection, polarization, and multi-peak analysis.
overviewZh: 基于商用共焦拉曼显微镜改装，可在受控加热或电学加载下扫描声子光谱。温度与应力通过标定、模态选择、偏振和多峰分析进行解耦。
principle: Inelastic light scattering probes lattice vibrations. Calibrated peak shifts, linewidths or anti-Stokes/Stokes ratios can indicate temperature; strain also shifts or splits peaks. Temperature and stress therefore require suitable mode-specific calibration or independent constraints. Probe-laser heating must be assessed before spatial mapping.
principleZh: 非弹性光散射探测晶格振动。经标定的峰位、线宽或反斯托克斯／斯托克斯强度比可用于测温，应变也会引起峰移或劈裂。温度与应力需通过适当的模态标定或独立约束区分，空间扫描前还需评估探测激光自身的加热。
